result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a dedicated bike lane, providing a baseline level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, a large vehicle parked near the crossing creates a significant visual obstruction, and the lack of curb extensions increases the unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large van is positioned right before the crosswalk, significantly blocking the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, left side of the road near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The crossing lacks a median or refuge island, requiring pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic in one go.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The environment features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The presence of parked vehicles right up to the crossing creates significant sightline obstructions for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk block the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides leading up to the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signalization
hazards.description: While a traffic light is present, there are no visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the traffic light pole

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

result.summary: The image shows a commercial street with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.
